curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a cunning mockingbird outwit a relentless ruler long enough for two young lovers to make their escape?
curatedMovie.description: In Paul Grimault's animated French fantasy, a young shepherdess and a chimneysweep attempt to elude a tyrannical king who is determined to marry her, aided by a witty mockingbird who opposes the crown.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting, charming, and briskly paced, this imaginative animated fairy tale offers an accessible, family-friendly escape.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This 1980 French animation balances whimsical humor with daring momentum, crafting an inventive fairy tale of romantic defiance across an accessible eighty-three minutes.
